victorqribeiro/fingerPool
https://github.com/victorqribeiro/fingerPool
pin: a1da529849948b9f770df29ee1f3443d8958c4e7
MIT, Copyright (c) 2021 Victor Ribeiro

Vec2.js and Sphere.js are the upstream files at that pin.

The flick is from main.js at that pin:

  angle = atan2(start.y - end.y, start.x - end.x)
  l     = -max(distance / dt * 12, 7)
  acc   = (cos(angle) * l, sin(angle) * l)

Rack: 15 coloured balls in a triangle, white at two-thirds along the
long side. Pockets: four corners plus the middle of each long side.
Friction 0.98 per frame. Equal-mass projection bounce. White respawns.

This copy letterboxes a 2:1 table so two devices share one shape
(upstream used the whole window and stacked the triangle on a tall
screen). Sounds are short tones — the original hit.mp3 / hole.mp3 are
not packed. Take-turns and the score are the GifOS port; upstream had
no rules and no networking.
